parsed.critic: High cement with zero or low superplasticizer (C06, C09) risks poor workability and segregation, and RF tree disagreement (~8-11 MPa) means predictions are estimates only.
parsed.selection_rationale: C01/C02 mirror the strongest observed slag-bearing mix-370, C05 adds slag with high coarse aggregate for plausible upside, and C03/C06 test the cement-cementitious boundary.

decision.hypothesis: Among top-predicted mixes, high cement (>=440 kg/m3) with modest slag and low fly ash will out-measure the high-fly-ash/low-cement group.
decision.critic: High cement with zero or low superplasticizer (C06, C09) risks poor workability and segregation, and RF tree disagreement (~8-11 MPa) means predictions are estimates only.
decision.selection_rationale: C01/C02 mirror the strongest observed slag-bearing mix-370, C05 adds slag with high coarse aggregate for plausible upside, and C03/C06 test the cement-cementitious boundary.
